candidates.name: Reuse existing generic primitive as-is
candidates.rejectionReason: Falsified executably. No expected-base parameter exists; boolean return cannot express STALE; the internal for(;;) CAS-retry loop rebases a stale caller onto the winner's state and lets it overwrite the winner; accepted sequence advances once per attempt rather than once per accepted commit.

evidence.e3-contract: S01VersionedStateHolderContrastTest.surfaceCannotExpressExpectedBase: every tryUpdate overload returns boolean and none accepts an expected base.
evidence.concurrency-correctness: S01VersionedStateHolderContrastTest.staleCallerIsRebasedAndOverwritesWinner: builder invocations=2, bases handed=[0,1], stale caller told it succeeded, final state is the stale caller's value.
evidence.jmm-clarity: AtomicReference publication is sound, but the side-effect-free builder contract on which correctness depends is enforced only by Javadoc (VersionedStateHolder.java lines 15-17).
evidence.hot-path: current() is a single ref.get(); zero allocation.
evidence.ownership: platform-tracing-otel is on the Spring application classpath: platform-tracing-spring-boot-autoconfigure/build.gradle line 9 implementation project(':platform-tracing-otel').
evidence.misuse-resistance: SamplerStateHolder.update(SamplerState) line 64 performs holder.tryUpdate(prev -> newState), an unconditional set ignoring prev; PlatformSamplingControl hand-writes prev.version()+1 at lines 43, 86, 118, 167, 215.
evidence.deletion-value: Consolidates nothing; three holders and four version-increment owners remain.
evidence.api-simplicity: Small surface, but UnaryOperator plus Predicate plus a side-effect-free requirement is subtle.
evidence.testability: VersionedStateHolderTest exists and is thorough for the LKG contract.

candidates.name: Constrained refactor of the generic primitive
candidates.rejectionReason: Would break the eight existing call sites that depend on rebase, or require dual mutation modes on one primitive which the pre-production policy forbids. runtimeInstanceId is an Agent-lifecycle concept that a domain-neutral primitive can only carry as an opaque token or via a pluggable identity abstraction, which is generic-framework drift. Ownership is also wrong: the module is on the Spring application classpath.

evidence.e3-contract: Reachable in principle, but runtimeInstanceId does not exist in production (zero matches outside E2E fixtures and docs) and is not domain-neutral.
evidence.concurrency-correctness: Expected-base semantics are achievable once the retry loop is removed.
evidence.ownership: platform-tracing-spring-boot-autoconfigure/build.gradle line 9 places platform-tracing-otel on the application classloader; no gate prevents a second policy owner there.
evidence.misuse-resistance: Retaining tryUpdate alongside a new commit keeps the unconditional-set path reachable; removing tryUpdate breaks three holders and five inline JMX sites.
evidence.deletion-value: Could eventually consolidate the three holders.
evidence.api-simplicity: Two mutation modes, or a generic identity abstraction; both are framework drift.
evidence.migration-risk: Invalidates the committed contract of VersionedStateHolderTest.concurrentUpdatesAreSerializedWithoutLoss, which asserts all 16000 concurrent updates succeed, plus eight production call sites, for a benefit only the tracing domain requires.

candidates.name: Agent-specific accepted-state primitive
candidates.symbol: proposed; production naming is P1 work

evidence.e3-contract: All 17 invariants satisfied; 27 tests, 0 failures. Expected base carries runtimeInstanceId and acceptedSequence; outcome is APPLIED or STALE only.
evidence.concurrency-correctness: S01OneWinnerCommitTest: 250 rounds x 8 concurrent writers on one shared expected base; exactly 1 APPLIED and 7 STALE every round; sequence +1 every round; 2000 attempts produced 250 accepted commits.
evidence.jmm-clarity: One AtomicReference holding one immutable all-final-field envelope; no retry loop. S01PublicationVisibilityTest: 20000 commits x 6 unsynchronised readers, zero torn or partial observations.
evidence.hot-path: JMH readAcceptedRatio 0.890 ns/op at gc.alloc.rate.norm ~1e-6 B/op; HotSpot per-thread counter shows exactly 0 bytes over 2000000 reads.
evidence.ownership: Extension module absence from the application classpath is already asserted by root build.gradle line 472 and gradle/c3-published-consumer/build.gradle lines 44 and 46.
evidence.misuse-resistance: S01ApiMisuseTest, 8 assertions: surface is exactly {current, commit}; no set/put/replace/reset/update/getAndSet/force method; no method accepts an envelope; sequence has no mutator; runtimeInstanceId is mandatory and non-null; CAS payload components are exactly (runtimeInstanceId, acceptedSequence, policy); consecutive reads return the same instance.
evidence.deletion-value: Replaces 3 holders, 3 independent version lines, and 4 version-increment owners across 8 increment sites.
evidence.api-simplicity: Five small types, no interface, no factory, no registry, no adapter, no SPI. Net production types and net mutable owners both decrease. Not 5/5 only because five types is not one.
evidence.testability: Every invariant is directly assertable; reference identity gives a seam-free no-CAS observable.
evidence.migration-risk: Real P1 and P3 work, but confined to one module and one rollback unit, with the three existing holders left intact throughout P1.

candidates.name: Bare AtomicReference<ImmutableState>, no abstraction
candidates.rejectionReason: AtomicReference exposes set, getAndSet and raw compareAndSet to every caller, so the unconditional-set path stays trivially reachable and acceptedSequence has no owner at all. Expected-base checking would have to be hand-written at every call site with nothing enforcing it.

evidence.e3-contract: Achievable only if every call site hand-writes the expected-base check.
evidence.concurrency-correctness: No structural guarantee; correctness depends on every call site being right.
evidence.hot-path: Identical mechanism to the selected candidate. This is the baseline's value: candidate D adds zero hot-path cost over bare AtomicReference, measured at 0.890 ns/op and 0 bytes.
evidence.ownership: Placement is possible but ownership is unexpressed in the type system.
evidence.misuse-resistance: set, getAndSet and compareAndSet are public to all callers.
evidence.testability: Nothing to test but call sites.
evidence.migration-risk: Every call site must be audited and re-audited on change.
